Receipt Rule — Edit

The Receipt Rule form is used to create automatic categorization rules for receipts.

Rules automatically assign accounts and other fields based on transaction descriptions.

If bank account is:

Select the specific bank or cash account where this receipt rule should apply.

Leave this field empty to apply the rule to receipts in any bank or cash account.

Account-specific rules are useful when different accounts receive different types of income.

... and amount is

Choose how to match receipt amounts for this rule:

Any amount - Matches receipts of any value

Exactly - Matches only the exact amount specified

More than - Matches amounts greater than specified

Less than - Matches amounts less than specified

AndAmountIsAmount

Enter the amount value for the matching condition you selected.

This field is only required when using Exactly, More than, or Less than conditions.

Conditions

Enter keywords that must appear in the transaction description for this rule to match.

Add multiple conditions to create precise matching rules - all conditions must be met.

Use specific keywords like customer names, invoice numbers, or payment references for accurate matching.

Paid by

Select who made this payment:

Customer - For payments from your customers

Supplier - For refunds or credits from suppliers

Other - For payments from other sources not in your contact lists

Customer

Select the specific customer who made this payment.

This will automatically allocate the receipt to the customer's account.

Supplier

Select the supplier who issued this refund or credit.

This might be used for supplier refunds, rebates, or returned goods credits.

OtherContact

Enter the name of the payer when they are not in your customer or supplier lists.

Use this for one-time receipts or payments from parties you don't regularly transact with.

Lines

Configure how matched receipts will be categorized in your accounts.

You can allocate the entire receipt to one account or split it across multiple accounts.

Use the Add line button to split receipts that contain multiple income types.

Column — Description

Enable the Description column to add detailed descriptions for each line item.

Useful for providing additional context about different income components in split receipts.

Column — Qty

Enable the Qty column to record quantities for items sold or services provided.

Essential when the receipt involves inventory sales or billable services with quantity tracking.
